1434205.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 5M LED fairy lights create warm decorative lighting indoors and outdoors
- Battery operated design allows flexible placement without sockets
- Remote control with multiple lighting modes for easy customisation
- Weather-resistant construction suitable for patios and gardens
- Timer function automatically switches lights off for convenience
- Ideal for Christmas decor, bedrooms, parties, and balconies

## Information
Decorate your home, bedroom, garden or patio with the Globrite 5M LED Fairy Lights. Designed for indoor and outdoor use, these battery operated string lights add a warm decorative glow to festive displays, parties, Christmas trees, balconies and everyday room decor. The battery-powered design allows flexible placement without needing nearby sockets, making these lights ideal for hard-to-reach spaces, garlands, wreaths, wall decor and outdoor decorations. The included remote control lets you easily switch between multiple lighting modes including twinkle, flashing and steady glow settings to suit different occasions and moods. Built with weather-resistant materials, these fairy lights are suitable for seasonal outdoor displays and year-round decorative use around patios, fences and balconies. The timer function helps automate operation for added convenience while preserving battery life. Featuring 50, 100 and 200 bright LED lights across a 5 metre string, these decorative lights provide excellent coverage while remaining lightweight and easy to install. Available in Warm White, Cool White and Multi-colour options, they suit a wide range of decorative styles and occasions.

1442105.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Energy efficient led bulbs:Warm,Cool,Copper,rgb
- Flexible weatherproof cable for easy installation
- Ip65 rated with waterproof ends for indoor outdoor use

## Information
Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a black rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long lasting and energy efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White, Warm White, Copper Gold or RGB Colour Changing to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.

With LEDs spaced apart on a cable, these lights seamlessly blend into any Christmas scene, adding a warm and inviting glow. Powered by 3 'C' batteries (not supplied), these lights come with a convenient lead from the weatherproof battery box to the first bulb. You can easily switch between 8 different lighting functions, including static, combination, in waves, sequential, slow glow, chasing flash, slow fade, and twinkle flash, to create your desired ambience. The lights also feature a memory chip to retain your previous setting, along with a 6-hour on, 18-hour off timer function for battery conservation.
